title: Headcount Debrief Templates + Action Tracker (scratchpad)
content:
Purpose: quick scratchpad to (1) standardize debriefs for interviewers, (2) track outstanding asks from HC syncs, and (3) surface blockers for filled vs open roles.

Status notes (as of 2024-11-04):
- Headcount target for Q4 is +14 FTEs (engineering + product heavy). Hiring freeze lifted for IC roles but manager hiring needs additional sign-off.
- Pipeline: 9 offers extended (3 pending candidate replies), 11 active loops, 6 candidates in take-home/code assignment.
- Budget ask: +2 headcount above org ask (platform infra urgencies). Need finance approval by 2024-11-15.

Agenda for 1:1 with Benji (people-ops lead) — 2024-11-05:
- Quick HC delta review (open vs committed). Bring table: role / hiring stage / expected start (mm/yyyy) / owner.
- Interview loop quality: 3 recent debriefs flagged inconsistent scoring (see sampling below). Decide rubric changes.
- Approvals pipeline: I&E (finance) flagged two director-level roles; define next steps.
- Offer velocity: blocking questions from recruiting (counteroffers, comp bands).
- Action alignment: who follows up with managers for updated JD?

Sampling of inconsistent debriefs (observed patterns):
- Interviewer A: strong technical, weak system design but gave 8/10 on overall; no rationale.
- Interviewer B: cultural fit leads to lower score but no concrete examples.
- Interviewer C: heavy preference for previous stack; commented on irrelevant tooling.

Proposed debrief template (short) — put as a comment in interviewer invite: 
1) Role fit: rate 1-5 + 1-sentence justification (concrete example).
2) Technical depth: 1-5 + one specific strength/weakness observed.
3) System design/architecture: 1-5 + 1 note on tradeoffs discussed.
4) Communication & collaboration: 1-5 + example.
5) Recommendation: hire | consider | no-hire + reason (2 lines).
6) Risk flags: background, relocation, visa, IC/manager mismatch.

Debrief enforcement ideas (cheap):
- Add the template to calendar invite copy for all loop interviews.
- Auto-fill checklist in recruiter form (required field before loop closed).
- Random audit: QA 10% of debriefs weekly for completeness; escalate patterns to hiring manager.

Comp bands and offer guidance (notes for Benji):
- Senior IC (L4-L5): comp band B3-B4; hiring manager must confirm top of band exception via an email.
- Staff+ (L6+): require director-level budget sign-off + compensation note in pipeline doc.
- Counteroffer playbook: rapid 24-48h follow-up from recruiter + 1x hiring manager touchpoint.

Action tracker (things to bring to HC sync / follow-up):
- (A) Finance approval for +2 infra headcount — Owner: Arya — Due: 2024-11-15 — NOTE: attach cost delta and expected Q1 impact.
- (B) Update debrief rubric and push to interviewer invites — Owner: Benji — Due: 2024-11-08.
- (C) Recruiter: compile list of top 10 pipeline candidates with expected start dates — Owner: Sam Park — Due: 2024-11-07.
- (D) Managers: confirm interviewers for open platform roles (avoid overlapping interviewer fatigue) — Owner: hiring managers — Due: 2024-11-06.
- (E) Legal/immigration check on 2 international offers — Owner: People Ops legal — Due: 2024-11-09.

Notes for interview loop fixes (engineering-heavy):
- Reduce loop length from 5 to 4 interviews for majority of IC L4 roles (save cost/time) — propose: screen / take-home / tech + design / culture.
- Take-home assignment: standardize rubric & target time = 3–4 hours. Make explicit in candidate-facing instructions.
- Interviewer calibration session: 45m weekly slot for top interviewers to align scoring (sample sessions: Wed 10–10:45).

Decision matrix for closeouts (quick reference):
- Hire immediately: 3+ 'hire' recs, no fatal risk flags, comp within band.
- Consider (pause): mixed signals, one 'no-hire' with concrete risk; recruit to gather another data point.
- Decline: 2+ 'no-hire' or one critical risk (visa, culture mismatch).

Questions I want answered by Benji in the sync:
- Can we require 1-line justification for each numeric score in the ATS (Greenhouse)? If not, alternative?
- Who signs off on >10% comp band exceptions — is it still finance+people ops? Clarify.
- Are we pausing manager hires above L5 until budget sign-off? Need clarity for managers to avoid false offers.

Quick links / refs to paste into calendar invite:
- HC plan confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/HR/Q4+HC+Plan
- Recent audit notes: Google Drive /shared_drives/people-ops/hiring-audits/oct-2024
- Example JIRA: JIRA-HR-412 — "approve-infra-headcount"

Scratch questions/notes to self (loose):
- Consider flagging 'interviewer fatigue' metric in recruiting report (highly overlapping panels).
- Evaluate whether two-stage take-home (short + long) reduces bias — maybe too heavy.
- Add a line in offer template for expected ramp timeline + first 90-day deliverables (helps managers and candidate alignment).

Closing: bring a concise 1-pager to HC sync with: (1) top 5 role risks, (2) 3 quick process changes we can implement this week (debrief template in invites, required debrief fields, 45m calibration slot), (3) ask list for finance/legal.

Appendix: sample email to hiring managers to request interviewers (draft)
Subject: Quick — confirm interviewers for [ROLE] (target start [mm/yyyy])
Body (short): Hey <Manager>, we’re aiming to close the loop for <ROLE>. Please confirm 4 interviewers (tech, design, culture, hiring manager) by EOD 2024-11-06. If overlap across roles >2 same interviewer/week, flag and we’ll help rebalance.

-- end scratchpad --
